mainEntity.name: How many coats does an interior door usually need for a good finish?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most interior doors need two coats, and sometimes a third if you’re changing from a dark color to a light one or covering stains. Thin coats matter more than heavy coverage because thick paint can leave brush marks, runs, and slow drying. A good prep job also helps the finish look smoother and last longer.
acceptedAnswer.description: Two thin coats are typical for interior doors, with a third coat sometimes needed for major color changes. Thin application gives a smoother look and reduces drips and brush marks.
